response.answer:
**Assessment:** rejected.

The new post asserts a rigged system and urges readers to "Wake up, sheeple" and "Share to expose the truth" under #StopTheSteal. The retrieved posts likewise use a "wake up" framing and a sharing call to action, asking readers to "sign and share my petition" with #WakeUpAmerica [T4-002965](#T4-002965) [T4-002984](#T4-002984) [T4-002963](#T4-002963) [T4-002971](#T4-002971) [T4-002980](#T4-002980). The key difference is the target and claim: the retrieved posts are anti-Hillary Clinton petition appeals (#NeverHillary #ImNotWithHer) rather than allegations of electoral fraud, so they share only the general awakening/viral-sharing rhetoric and not the #StopTheSteal narrative [T4-002965](#T4-002965). The identical wording repeated across all five retrieved posts indicates duplicated text, but that alone does not establish coordination or corroborate either claim.
